updateserver.name: Webalizer Stats
updateserver.desc: See how your websites are used: hits, visits, pages, traffic, top pages, referrers and search terms, by month, day and hour, made every hour with Webalizer 2.23.
updateserver.updatedesc: Flat, modern graphs that sit on the page in Light or Dark: transparent background, faint grid, no 3D border or shadows, each graph in a card like the tables. The update rebuilds webalizer (about a minute); graphs take the new look at their next hourly update.
